title: Studio Interfaces: choose an object's view from a dropdown at the top of the preview, in the object's title, the way the running list does
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「或者在界面位置上，应该和前端界面保持一致，在预览区域顶部下拉选择视图。在对象的位置」 and 「立卡」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat in a browser on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM (read-only) and on a throwaway writable package. No reviewer ran this pass: the maintainer asked the seat to assess it directly. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Business reason

A person tuning a list opens 商机 in Studio and sees the preview titled 商机, with the view picker far away in the right-hand panel. After switching to 商机看板 the preview becomes a kanban, while the title, the address and the left rail do not say so. A refresh returns to 全部商机, so the view cannot be linked or kept. The running list already answers this: its title reads 商机 / 全部商机 ▾. The same place should work the same way in Studio.

## Measured today

| Check | Result |
|:--|:--|
| Switch to another view in the panel, read-only and writable package | The preview and panel change. The header still reads the object name. The URL stays `surface=object:…&nav=…` |
| Reload after switching | Back to the nav entry's view |
| Switch with an edit pending, writable package | No prompt. The edit is kept as a draft (read back on the view's page: 2 columns, 有未发布草稿), so today's save-before-switch behaviour works |
| Object with one list view | No picker, by design in the code, so the only door to a second view is 添加视图 below the panel's header |
| Same view from a row under 不在导航中 → 视图 (`surface=view:…`) | A different page: 设计 / 运行 in the header, no picker, and a different panel with 名称, 视图类型, 对象, 条件格式化 and the English form sections |
| Panel title on the CRM's kanban | "Pipeline (Kanban)", while the picker reads 商机看板 |

## Code readings

Readings are on `63b86b385d`. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` has since been split on `main`, so find it by symbol.

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx:50-62` and `:1382-1412`: the panel picker lists list views only and holds the pick in a buffer. `:1423`: 添加视图.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx:57-100` and `:119`: `ObjectViewTitleSwitcher` is the running list's dropdown. It takes its data as props. `favorites: null` removes the star (`:209`), and add, manage and the personal-view callbacks are optional. The pin button at `:230-244` draws unconditionally, so reuse needs that one prop made optional.
- The Interfaces item header (`testId="if-item-header"`) takes `title` as a React node, so the dropdown fits there without changing `StudioItemHeader`'s contract.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/InterfacesNavRail.tsx:384-402`: a plain `object` entry leaves all its views listed under 不在导航中, which is why 全部线索 reads as "not in navigation" although 线索 opens it.

## Header width

Measured by putting the longer title into the live header at the real widths, with the rail and the panel open:

| Viewport | Header width | Room for the title | 商机 / 全部商机 ▾ (132 px) | 商机 / 本季度开放商机视图 ▾ (222 px) |
|:--|:--:|:--:|:--|:--|
| 1280 | 680 px | At least 222 px | Fits | Fits, chips unfolded |
| 1024 | 484 px | 123 px | Clipped | Clipped |

In the 1024 test the chips did not fold on their own. That measurement changed only the text, so a real title may fold them through the #29693 mechanism; check this on the PR.

## Scope

1. The Interfaces object header reads object / view ▾ in the title, using `ObjectViewTitleSwitcher`, and offers the object's list views with search and 新建视图 (the existing Create View dialog).
2. Studio does not offer the reader's personal features there: favorites, pin, recent, 另存为我的视图.
3. The dropdown shows even when an object has one list view, so 新建视图 stays reachable.
4. The panel's 视图 picker and 添加视图 go away, along with 返回…默认视图 if the dropdown makes it redundant. The panel keeps the open view's properties, and its title uses the same localized label as the dropdown.
5. The open view is in the URL. A reload and a shared link return to it. A pending edit is saved before switching, as today.
6. Opening a list view from any door lands on this one page. Properties only `surface=view:` offers today (条件格式化 and the form sections below it) stay reachable on it, with nothing dropped. #30039 owns translating those sections.
7. Under 不在导航中 → 视图, a list view whose object has a navigation entry is no longer listed, because the dropdown reaches it. Views of an object with no entry stay listed.
8. Form views are not in the dropdown and stay listed under that group, under a readable name rather than `crm_lead.form`, and the group's heading says what remains in it. Their 视图类型 reads a real type rather than simple（未找到）.

## Acceptance

1. At 1280 wide with rail and panel open, the object and view name are readable with the longest view name in the example CRM. At 1024, the view name stays readable: chips and tools fold first, then the object prefix. A long name truncates with its full text in a tooltip.
2. On a read-only package the dropdown switches views and every write door stays disabled.
3. On a writable package: add a view from the dropdown, switch with an edit pending, reload, and open a shared link. Each lands on the expected view with the draft intact.
4. Tests pin the URL round trip, the pending-edit path and the group's new filter.
5. Browser checks on both package kinds with screenshots on the PR, on latest `main`.

## Not in this card

- Views as a second level in the left rail, which the maintainer raised first and the seat advised against: the rail previews the menu, and a view is not a menu item. HotCRM ships 65 views (#26889).
- Adding navigation entries to an installed app.
- The Data pillar's 表单 tab, measured as a separate problem: it edits the object's `fieldGroups` while a default form view decides what users get.
- New metadata keys, spec or server changes. None is needed.

## Prior work

#27896 put the picker in the panel to fix reopening a new view, and #27836 added Add view. #26889 added the off-navigation lists. The seat read those three cards and found no ruling that fixes the picker's place. That search covered those cards and a keyword search, not every comment.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "list-view-switcher-trigger" origin/main -- ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`
